rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Fuxi (負屓), Fuxi, the dragon-shaped son associated with literature and coiling around stone steles. Native square PNG at least 1024 by 1024 pixels.
ANATOMY: a single living dragon-shaped coiling creature, one head with two eyes; one continuous flexible coiled body encircling the top of a stone stele; deliberately no wings, jewellery or invented magical features, feet out of crop [wd-q757989-c02, wd-q757989-c07]
MOMENT: UNCOIL its head down around the stele top toward the low viewer, throat bending forward and gaze alert, unmistakably living rather than a stone ornament
POWER: no documented magic; no visible energy effects [wd-q757989-c01, wd-q757989-c02]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle, tight foreshortened framing; no invented gigantic size
LIGHT & WEATHER: a single slanting warm sunset shaft, deep walnut shadows, strong rim light
SURFACE: tactile dark bronze-brown scales and rough weathered stone
SETTING: top of a weathered stone stele, broad face plain and devoid of all text or carved symbols [wd-q757989-c02]
MOOD: imposing and awe-inspiring or menacing as appropriate to the documented character; never cute, calm or decorative. The creature itself dominates and remains striking at 200 pixels.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, glyphs, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, coloured magic mist or energy ribbons. CORRECTION: HARD OVERRIDE: NO horns anywhere, NO dorsal spikes or crest, NO whiskers or beard, NO wings or feet in frame. Simple smooth-brow scaled dragon head and coiling neck only. Bring head much closer to occupy central two thirds; crop stele to upper edge/corner rather than large slab occupying bottom half. Single living dragon with two eyes coiling atop blank stele, no added features.
